chunks: He said, "O Iblis, what is it that you did not join those who bowed in homage?"

key_terms.إِبْلِيسُ: Iblis (Satan), the jinn who refused to prostrate to Adam

ai.seo_question: Why did God ask Iblis 'What is it that you did not join those who bowed?' in Surah Al-A'raf?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the distinction between the obedient angels and Iblis, who is often interpreted as a jinn or an early angelic being who refused to prostrate out of pride, claiming superiority over Adam. The rhetorical question 'What is wrong with you?' highlights the sudden deviation from divine command, serving as a foundational narrative for the origin of evil and the test of free will in human creation.
